sentences.text: To solve the issue where hair obstructs electrode contact during brain signal recording, researchers developed eHAIR, a method that converts hair into an electronic interface using special conductive polymer dyes.

The team evaluated two approaches involving polythiophene dyes for coating hair groups or individual strands, creating low-resistance connections that yielded stronger signals with improved frequency details and local amplification dependent on hair shape.
The authors present this system as a wearable platform capable of functioning on single hairs or larger hairy areas.
